assert_is_instance_check_type: assert an object is an instance of a given class and raise TypeError if not
assert_is_instance_validate_obj: validate that an object matches an expected class type before proceeding
none_throws_guard_none: throw a ValueError when a value is None instead of allowing it to propagate
none_throws_custom_message: throw a ValueError with a custom message when a value is None
none_throws_unwrap_optional: unwrap an optional value and raise ValueError if it is None
